research_scope: child psychiatry institutional guidance, systematic reviews of school-refusal interventions and absenteeism, CBT/exposure and parent-school coordination evidence, functional assessment literature, Arabic parent search intent, existing-site overlap
nosology_note: School refusal is a descriptive/functional presentation rather than a single DSM or ICD diagnosis. Assessment must identify the maintaining function and possible anxiety, depression, bullying, learning, neurodevelopmental, family, medical, sleep or school-environment contributors.

existing_site_overlap.decision: cross-link when low mood, loss of interest and withdrawal are prominent; school refusal itself is not synonymous with depression
cross-link when fear of scrutiny, presentations, eating or speaking in front of peers drives avoidance
cross-link when worries span multiple domains rather than school attendance alone
preserve as exam-stress guide when attendance difficulty is concentrated around examinations rather than a broader school-refusal pattern
preserve as family observation guide; school refusal page focuses attendance, function and coordinated return
